decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program costs little to run on existing production, is still mentioned in both years, and its value in a growing market remains uncertain, so the option is worth keeping.
The seventy-two-hour program is costlier to sustain and overlaps with the other express offers, but it is still visible and not clearly failing, so keeping the option open remains justified.
The express program for doors and gates has kept a dedicated page in both years, which signals continued commitment and an option that is still unresolved at low carrying cost.
The digital ordering platform builds a strategic service capability with a dedicated presence, and its value is still unfolding while further operation costs little once built.
The fire and smoke protection door was upgraded from a mention to its own page, showing that uncertainty is resolving favorably, and it likely took over the role of the dropped fire-resistant door C.
